purpose: Isolate why the reproduced yolo26s DP=8 throughput (227 img/s) is far below the reference 1523 img/s. Same NEFF, same batch, only the dispatch path varies.

results.name: C. Explicit per-core placement via neuron_cores_context + ThreadPoolExecutor

conclusion: Upstream notebook leaves ~2.5x on the table by accepting torch_neuronx.DataParallel's default num_workers=2, which serialises 8 cores through a 2-thread pool. Explicit placement + ThreadPool gives another +18% on top.
